features.description: 5-case integration test for TTL + archival flow
acceptance_criteria: Case 1: fresh mint → expires_at ≈ now + 300d
Case 2: clock-forward past 30d → code still valid (regression guard for old default)
Case 3: clock-forward past 300d → GroupExpired raised
Case 4: expired code → restore returns 410 + ChatSessionIndex.archived=True
Case 5: re-restore on archived session → 410 (idempotent), no double-archive Firestore write
All 5 cases run via `make test-fast` using in-memory fixture (backend/db/firestore_inmemory.py)
Backwards-compat: pre-existing JWT with expires_at = mint + 30*86400 still validates until its own expires_at
features.notes: Mark slow only if real Firestore is needed; prefer in-memory fixture for `make test-fast` inclusion.
